# References

What shaped Fogwright's look, collected from our design conversations.

## In this folder

**Turnaround sheets** (`sheets/`): front and side views of each people's base body, generated by the project owner. The body build fits each people to its sheet (see `tools/fit`).

| File | People | Used for |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [aurelan-turnaround.webp](sheets/aurelan-turnaround.webp) | Aurelan man and woman | The fitted Aurelan bodies (Devlog 46) |
| [hrimfolk-turnaround.webp](sheets/hrimfolk-turnaround.webp) | Hrimfolk man and woman | Next to fit |
| [ilvari-turnaround.webp](sheets/ilvari-turnaround.webp) | Ilvari man and woman | Next to fit |

**Screenshots** (`screenshots/`): our own prototype, captured on a phone during reviews.

| File | What it shows |
| --- | --- |
| [tinker-model-review.jpg](screenshots/tinker-model-review.jpg) | The first Tinker hero model review |
| [prototype-1.jpg](screenshots/prototype-1.jpg), [prototype-2.jpg](screenshots/prototype-2.jpg) | The early prototype: the field, a gate and the HUD |
| [female-body-study.jpg](screenshots/female-body-study.jpg) | The female body study, front and back |

## Not stored here

These came from other artists and games. They are listed so the inspiration is recorded, but the images aren't in this public repository.

| Reference | What we took from it |
| --- | --- |
| Steampunk Tinker concept art (five pieces, various artists) | The hero's look: brass armour, goggles, mechanical arms, a hand cannon |
| Valheim (three video thumbnails) | Base bodies in plain underclothes, so every outfit starts from the same body; merged, chunky hair and beards; posture and hands |
| House and city concept art (seven pieces, various artists) | Leaning, layered timber-and-stone houses, tall towers and crowded steampunk streets for Aldrath's city |
| World of Warcraft blood elves (five screenshots) | The women's proportions: slim waist, round bust, slender neck, soft shoulders and graceful faces |
| World of Warcraft character sizes | Clear size differences between peoples, and silhouettes that tell them apart |

The Sketchfab "Simple RPG Human Male" model, which the character bodies are rebuilt from, is also kept out of the repository until its licence is confirmed (see `CREDITS.md`).
